en: A colorful, humorous postcard featuring cartoon-like ostriches wearing hiking boots, walking among orange gladiolus flowers on a blue and white background. One large ostrich in the foreground also wears boots and has gladiolus flowers on its back. A speech bubble in Dutch appears in the center, and a web address is shown in a banner near the top. At the bottom, text references the '4 Daagse Nijmegen', the famous multi‑day walking event.
